attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: pdf-article-extraction-via-ai-vision

steps:
  - id: search_pending_pdfs
    op: google_drive/search_files
    params:
      folder_id: "pending_articles_folder_id"
      mime_type: "application/pdf"
      query: "mimeType='application/pdf' and trashed=false"
    output: pdf_files

  - id: download_pdf_binary
    op: google_drive/download_file
    params:
      file_id: "{{ pdf_files[0].id }}"
      format: binary
    output: pdf_binary

  - id: send_to_ai_vision
    op: ai_vision/extract_content
    params:
      model: "gpt-4-vision"
      input: "{{ pdf_binary }}"
      prompt: |
        Extract structured content from this PDF article. Return a JSON object with the following fields:
        - title (string, required)
        - author (string)
        - section (string, required)
        - lead (string, must not be empty)
        - content (string, required)
        - highlighted_quotes (array of strings)
        - sidebars (array of objects with title and body)
        - es_multiple (boolean)

        If the PDF contains multiple book reviews rather than a single article, set es_multiple to true
        and return a "reviews" array where each element contains the fields above.

        Return ONLY valid JSON. Replace any double quotes inside text content with single quotes
        to preserve JSON validity.
    output: ai_raw_response

  - id: parse_ai_response
    op: transform/parse_json
    params:
      input: "{{ ai_raw_response }}"
      strip_markdown_fences: true
      operations:
        - action: regex_replace
          pattern: "```json?"
          replacement: ""
        - action: regex_replace
          pattern: "```"
          replacement: ""
        - action: trim_whitespace
    output: parsed_content

  - id: replace_double_quotes_in_content
    op: transform/sanitize_strings
    params:
      input: "{{ parsed_content }}"
      fields_to_sanitize:
        - title
        - lead
        - content
        - highlighted_quotes
        - sidebars.*.body
        - reviews.*.title
        - reviews.*.lead
        - reviews.*.content
        - reviews.*.highlighted_quotes
        - reviews.*.sidebars.*.body
      replace:
        from: '"'
        to: "'"
    output: sanitized_content

  - id: validate_required_fields
    op: validate/check_fields
    params:
      input: "{{ sanitized_content }}"
      rules:
        - condition: "{{ sanitized_content.es_multiple == true }}"
          required_fields_per_item:
            array_field: reviews
            fields:
              - field: title
                not_empty: true
              - field: section
                not_empty: true
              - field: content
                not_empty: true
              - field: lead
                not_empty: true
                error_message: "Lead field must never be empty"
        - condition: "{{ sanitized_content.es_multiple != true }}"
          required_fields:
            - field: title
              not_empty: true
            - field: section
              not_empty: true
            - field: content
              not_empty: true
            - field: lead
              not_empty: true
              error_message: "Lead field must never be empty"
      on_failure: raise_error
    output: validated_content

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: article_category_matching_from_excel

steps:
  - id: read_category_spreadsheet
    op: google_drive/read_spreadsheet
    params:
      file_name: category_mapping
      sheet: Sheet1
    output: category_rows

  - id: extract_article_title
    op: data/extract_field
    params:
      source: extracted_article_data
      field: title
    output: article_title

  - id: normalise_article_title
    op: text/normalise
    params:
      input: "{{ article_title }}"
      remove_accents: true
      lowercase: true
      strip_non_alphanumeric: true
    output: normalised_article_title

  - id: normalise_spreadsheet_titles
    op: text/normalise_batch
    params:
      input: "{{ category_rows }}"
      field: title
      remove_accents: true
      lowercase: true
      strip_non_alphanumeric: true
    output: normalised_category_rows

  - id: fuzzy_match_category
    op: matching/fuzzy_lookup
    params:
      query: "{{ normalised_article_title }}"
      candidates: "{{ normalised_category_rows }}"
      match_field: normalised_title
      accent_insensitive: true
      punctuation_insensitive: true
    output: match_result

  - id: apply_matched_category
    op: conditional/if_then_else
    params:
      condition: "{{ match_result.found == true }}"
      if_true:
        op: data/set_fields
        params:
          source: extracted_article_data
          fields:
            category: "{{ match_result.row.category }}"
            section: "{{ match_result.row.section }}"
            needs_review: false
        output: categorised_article
      if_false:
        op: data/set_fields
        params:
          source: extracted_article_data
          fields:
            category: "Ciencia economica"
            section: "Dossier"
            needs_review: true
            review_reason: "No matching category found in spreadsheet for title"
        output: categorised_article
    output: categorised_article

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: drupal_metadata_lookup

steps:
  - id: lookup_author_entity
    op: cms_jsonapi_query
    params:
      endpoint: /jsonapi/node/author
      filter_field: title
      filter_value: "{{ article.author_name }}"
      method: GET
    output: author_result
    on_failure:
      op: flag_for_review
      params:
        article_id: "{{ article.id }}"
        reason: "Author not found – manual assignment required"
        flag_type: manual_author_assignment

  - id: lookup_category_term
    op: cms_jsonapi_query
    params:
      endpoint: /jsonapi/taxonomy_term/category
      filter_field: name
      filter_value: "{{ article.category_name }}"
      method: GET
    output: category_result
    on_failure:
      op: abort
      params:
        reason: "Category taxonomy term not found for '{{ article.category_name }}'"

  - id: lookup_magazine_issue
    op: cms_jsonapi_query
    params:
      endpoint: /jsonapi/node/magazine_issue
      filter_field: field_issue_number
      filter_value: "{{ article.magazine_issue_number }}"
      method: GET
    output: issue_result
    on_failure:
      op: abort
      params:
        reason: "Magazine issue not found for issue number '{{ article.magazine_issue_number }}'"

  - id: validate_all_lookups
    op: assert_all_present
    params:
      required:
        - "{{ author_result.data.id }}"
        - "{{ category_result.data.id }}"
        - "{{ issue_result.data.id }}"
      error_message: "One or more metadata lookups failed – cannot proceed with article creation"
    depends_on:
      - lookup_author_entity
      - lookup_category_term
      - lookup_magazine_issue

  - id: merge_metadata
    op: merge_records
    params:
      fields:
        author_entity_id: "{{ author_result.data.id }}"
        author_name: "{{ author_result.data.attributes.title }}"
        category_term_uuid: "{{ category_result.data.id }}"
        category_name: "{{ category_result.data.attributes.name }}"
        magazine_issue_uuid: "{{ issue_result.data.id }}"
        magazine_issue_number: "{{ issue_result.data.attributes.field_issue_number }}"
        article_id: "{{ article.id }}"
    depends_on:
      - validate_all_lookups
    output: article_metadata_record

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: cms_article_publication

steps:
  - id: retrieve_csrf_token
    op: http_request
    params:
      method: GET
      url: "{{cms_base_url}}/session/token"
      headers:
        Accept: text/plain
    output: csrf_token

  - id: authenticate_publisher
    op: http_request
    params:
      method: POST
      url: "{{cms_base_url}}/user/login"
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json
        X-CSRF-Token: "{{csrf_token}}"
      body:
        name: "{{publisher_username}}"
        pass: "{{publisher_password}}"
    output: auth_session

  - id: validate_article_payload
    op: schema_validate
    params:
      schema: cms_article_schema
      payload: "{{article_payload}}"
    output: validation_result

  - id: create_paragraph_blocks
    op: loop
    params:
      items: "{{article_payload.content_sections}}"
      step:
        id: create_paragraph_block
        op: http_request
        params:
          method: POST
          url: "{{cms_base_url}}/jsonapi/paragraph/content_block"
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json
            Accept: application/vnd.api+json
            X-CSRF-Token: "{{csrf_token}}"
          body:
            data:
              type: paragraph--content_block
              attributes:
                field_body:
                  value: "{{item.html}}"
                  format: full_html
    output: paragraph_blocks

  - id: create_article_node
    op: http_request
    params:
      method: POST
      url: "{{cms_base_url}}/jsonapi/node/article"
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json
        Accept: application/vnd.api+json
        X-CSRF-Token: "{{csrf_token}}"
      body:
        data:
          type: node--article
          attributes:
            title: "{{article_payload.title}}"
            field_summary: "{{article_payload.summary}}"
            field_category: "{{article_payload.category}}"
            field_tags: "{{article_payload.tags}}"
            field_author: "{{article_payload.author}}"
            status: true
          relationships:
            field_content_blocks:
              data: "{{paragraph_blocks | map(block => { type: 'paragraph--content_block', id: block.data.id })}}"
    output: article_node

  - id: validate_article_creation
    op: assertion
    params:
      conditions:
        - field: "{{article_node.data.id}}"
          operator: is_not_null
        - field: "{{article_node.data.attributes.status}}"
          operator: equals
          value: true
    output: creation_validated

  - id: write_audit_log
    op: audit_log
    params:
      event: article_published
      details:
        title: "{{article_node.data.attributes.title}}"
        node_id: "{{article_node.data.id}}"
        timestamp: "{{now_iso8601}}"
        published_by: "{{publisher_username}}"
    output: audit_entry

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: post_publication_file_management

steps:
  - id: move_pdf_to_completed
    op: google_drive/move_file
    params:
      file_id: "{{ trigger.source_pdf_file_id }}"
      source_folder: "{{ trigger.pending_folder_id }}"
      destination_folder: "{{ trigger.completados_folder_id }}"
    output: moved_file

  - id: read_category_spreadsheet
    op: google_sheets/read_spreadsheet
    params:
      spreadsheet_id: "{{ trigger.category_spreadsheet_id }}"
      sheet_name: "{{ trigger.category_sheet_name }}"
    output: spreadsheet_data

  - id: update_article_status
    op: google_sheets/update_row
    params:
      spreadsheet_id: "{{ trigger.category_spreadsheet_id }}"
      sheet_name: "{{ trigger.category_sheet_name }}"
      row_match_column: "article_id"
      row_match_value: "{{ trigger.article_id }}"
      updates:
        status: "published"
        published_date: "{{ now() }}"
        cms_url: "{{ trigger.published_url }}"
    output: updated_row

  - id: write_audit_log
    op: logging/write_audit_entry
    params:
      log_source: post_publication_file_management
      article_id: "{{ trigger.article_id }}"
      timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
      actions_completed:

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: user_login_with_2fa
steps:
  - id: receive_login_form
    op: receive_form_submission
    params:
      fields:
        - email
        - password
      source: login_form
    output: login_payload

  - id: validate_credentials
    op: authenticate_credentials
    params:
      email: "{{login_payload.email}}"
      password: "{{login_payload.password}}"
      lookup_table: users
    output: credential_result

  - id: check_login_rate_limit
    op: rate_limit_check
    params:
      key: "{{login_payload.client_ip}}"
      max_attempts: 10
      window_seconds: 60
      scope: login_attempt
    output: login_rate_limit_result
    on_failure:
      op: reject_request
      params:
        status: 429
        message: "Too many login attempts. Please try again later."

  - id: determine_2fa_method
    op: lookup_user_2fa_method
    params:
      user_id: "{{credential_result.user_id}}"
      supported_methods:
        - totp
        - email_code
    output: tfa_method

  - id: send_email_2fa_code
    op: generate_and_send_email_code
    params:
      user_id: "{{credential_result.user_id}}"
      email: "{{login_payload.email}}"
      code_length: 6
      code_expiry_seconds: 300
    output: email_code_token
    condition: "{{tfa_method.method == 'email_code'}}"

  - id: prompt_2fa_input
    op: await_user_input
    params:
      prompt_type: "{{tfa_method.method}}"
      token: "{{tfa_method.method == 'email_code' ? email_code_token.token : null}}"
    output: tfa_input

  - id: check_2fa_rate_limit
    op: rate_limit_check
    params:
      key: "{{tfa_input.token}}"
      max_attempts: 5
      window_seconds: 300
      scope: tfa_attempt
    output: tfa_rate_limit_result
    on_failure:
      op: reject_request
      params:
        status: 429
        message: "Too many 2FA attempts. Please wait and try again."

  - id: validate_2fa_code
    op: verify_2fa_code
    params:
      user_id: "{{credential_result.user_id}}"
      method: "{{tfa_method.method}}"
      submitted_code: "{{tfa_input.code}}"
      token: "{{tfa_input.token}}"
    output: tfa_validation_result

  - id: create_session
    op: create_user_session
    params:
      user_id: "{{credential_result.user_id}}"
      session_duration_hours: 8
      cookie_settings:
        httpOnly: true
        secure: true
        sameSite: strict
        max_age_seconds: 28800
    output: session

  - id: log_login_event
    op: write_audit_log
    params:
      event_type: user_login
      user_id: "{{credential_result.user_id}}"
      email: "{{login_payload.email}}"
      client_ip: "{{login_payload.client_ip}}"
      tfa_method: "{{tfa_method.method}}"
      session_id: "{{session.session_id}}"
      timestamp: "{{now()}}"
      compliance: SOX
    output: audit_record

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: document_upload_and_pipeline_trigger

steps:
  - id: receive_upload
    op: receive_document_upload
    params:
      source: knowledge_base_interface
      required_fields:
        - file
        - document_type
      accepted_formats:
        - PDF
        - DOCX
        - TXT
    output: uploaded_document

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate_and_authorize
    params:
      input: uploaded_document.user_context
      allowed_roles:
        - Editor
        - Admin
        - Developer
      action: upload_document
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_file_format
    op: validate_document_format
    params:
      file: uploaded_document.file
      document_type: uploaded_document.document_type
      rules:
        - condition: document_type == 'SED'
          required_format: DOCX
          error_message: "SED documents must be in DOCX format."
        - condition: document_type != 'SED'
          allowed_formats:
            - PDF
            - DOCX
            - TXT
          error_message: "Uploaded file format does not match the selected document type."
    output: validation_result

  - id: store_uploaded_file
    op: store_file
    params:
      file: uploaded_document.file
      destination_volume: uploads
      path_prefix: "documents/{{uploaded_document.document_type}}"
      metadata:
        uploaded_by: auth_result.user_id
        document_type: uploaded_document.document_type
        uploaded_at: "{{now}}"
      cache_control: "private, no-store"
    output: stored_file

  - id: trigger_extraction_pipeline
    op: invoke_pipeline_service
    params:
      service: document_extraction_pipeline
      payload:
        file_reference: stored_file.file_path
        document_type: uploaded_document.document_type
        file_format: validation_result.detected_format
        metadata:
          uploaded_by: auth_result.user_id
          upload_timestamp: stored_file.uploaded_at
      routing_key: "pipeline.{{uploaded_document.document_type}}"
    output: pipeline_response

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: business_rule_extraction_from_process_document

steps:
  - id: receive_document
    op: receive_upload
    params:
      source: upload_pipeline
      accepted_types:
        - application/pdf
        - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
        - text/plain
      timeout_seconds: 300
    output: raw_document

  - id: authenticate_pipeline
    op: authenticate
    params:
      method: service_account
      service: pipeline_service
      scopes:
        - document:read
        - rules:write
        - vectordb:write
    output: auth_token

  - id: extract_text
    op: extract_document_text
    params:
      document: "{{receive_document.raw_document}}"
      ocr_fallback: true
    output: document_text

  - id: extract_business_rules
    op: langgraph_llm_call
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      model: gpt-4
      timeout_seconds: 300
      prompt_template: >
        You are a business analyst. Given the following process document text,
        identify and extract each individual business rule. Return the rules as
        a JSON array where each element has the fields: rule_id (auto-generated
        sequential string), rule_text (the verbatim or closely paraphrased rule),
        category (e.g. approval, validation, routing, escalation), and
        source_section (the section or heading the rule was found under).
      input_text: "{{extract_text.document_text}}"
      response_format: json
    output: extracted_rules

  - id: validate_rules_structure
    op: schema_validation
    params:
      data: "{{extract_business_rules.extracted_rules}}"
      schema:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          required:
            - rule_id
            - rule_text
            - category
            - source_section
          properties:
            rule_id:
              type: string
            rule_text:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
            category:
              type: string
            source_section:
              type: string
      on_failure: abort
    output: validated_rules

  - id: store_rules
    op: database_batch_insert
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      table: business_rules
      records: "{{validate_rules_structure.validated_rules}}"
      additional_fields:
        status: pending_review
        searchable: false
        source_document_id: "{{receive_document.raw_document.document_id}}"
        created_at: "{{now()}}"
    output: stored_rules

  - id: generate_embeddings
    op: embedding_generation
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      texts: "{{validate_rules_structure.validated_rules[*].rule_text}}"
      model: text-embedding-ada-002
      dimensions: 4096
      timeout_seconds: 300
    output: rule_embeddings

  - id: store_embeddings
    op: vectordb_batch_upsert
    params:
      auth_token: "{{authenticate_pipeline.auth_token}}"
      database: pgvector
      table: rule_embeddings
      records:
        rule_ids: "{{store_rules.stored_rules[*].id}}"
        embeddings: "{{generate_embeddings.rule_embeddings}}"
      dimensions: 4096
      metadata:
        status: pending_review
        source_document_id: "{{receive_document.raw_document.document_id}}"
    output: stored_embedding_ids

steps:
  - id: receive_query
    op: receive_request

      method: POST

        - query_text

  - id: authenticate_user

      token_source: search_request.headers.authorization
      method: bearer_token

  - id: generate_embedding_and_search

    params:
      input_text: search_request.query_text
      embedding_model: text-embedding
      table: seds
      similarity_metric: cosine
      top_k: 20
    output: matching_seds

  - id: stream_per_sed_summaries

    params:
      source: matching_seds
      for_each: sed
      chunk_builder:
        type: sed_summary
        sed_id: sed.id
        title: sed.title
        score: sed.similarity_score
        summary: sed.summary_text
      stream_immediately: true
    output: streamed_sed_results

  - id: generate_synthesis

      model: gpt-4
      prompt_template: >

        produce a concise synthesis that highlights key themes, commonalities, and differences
        across the results.
      context: streamed_sed_results
      depends_on: stream_per_sed_summaries
    output: synthesis_text

  - id: stream_synthesis_chunk

    params:
      chunk_builder:
        type: synthesis
        content: synthesis_text
      final_chunk: true
    output: stream_complete

  - id: log_audit_trail

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: embeddings-backfill-cron
steps:
  - id: scheduled_trigger
    op: cron/schedule
    params:
      interval: "*/15 * * * *"
      container: wiki
      description: "Trigger embeddings backfill every 15 minutes"

  - id: read_records_missing_embeddings
    op: database/query
    params:
      description: "Read all rules, articles, and SEDs that have no corresponding embedding record"
      queries:
        - name: rules
          sql: >
            SELECT r.* FROM rules r
            LEFT JOIN embeddings e ON e.record_type = 'rule' AND e.record_id = r.id
            WHERE e.id IS NULL
        - name: articles
          sql: >
            SELECT a.* FROM articles a
            LEFT JOIN embeddings e ON e.record_type = 'article' AND e.record_id = a.id
            WHERE e.id IS NULL
        - name: seds
          sql: >
            SELECT s.* FROM seds s
            LEFT JOIN embeddings e ON e.record_type = 'sed' AND e.record_id = s.id
            WHERE e.id IS NULL
    output: records_without_embeddings

  - id: filter_missing_embeddings
    op: data/filter
    params:
      input: "{{ records_without_embeddings }}"
      condition: "record has no corresponding embedding"
      merge_collections:
        - source: rules
          record_type: rule
        - source: articles
          record_type: article
        - source: seds
          record_type: sed
    output: filtered_records

  - id: generate_and_store_embeddings
    op: loop/for_each
    params:
      collection: "{{ filtered_records }}"
      concurrency: 5
      retry:
        enabled: true
        max_attempts: 3
        backoff_seconds: 30
        description: "Handle AI cold start gracefully (2-3 min startup possible)"
      timeout_seconds: 300
      steps:
        - id: generate_embedding
          op: ai/generate_embedding
          params:
            text: "{{ item.content }}"
            record_id: "{{ item.id }}"
            record_type: "{{ item.record_type }}"
          output: embedding_vector

        - id: store_embedding
          op: database/insert
          params:
            table: embeddings
            data:
              record_id: "{{ item.id }}"
              record_type: "{{ item.record_type }}"
              embedding: "{{ embedding_vector }}"
              created_at: "{{ now() }}"

  - id: log_results
    op: logging/write
    params:
      destination: /var/log/backfill.log
      level: info
      message: >
        Embeddings backfill completed.
        Total records processed: {{ filtered_records | length }}.
        Rules: {{ records_without_embeddings.rules | length }},
        Articles: {{ records_without_embeddings.articles | length }},
        SEDs: {{ records_without_embeddings.seds | length }}.
        Timestamp: {{ now() }}

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: document_indexing_pipeline

steps:
  - id: receive_document
    op: receive_event
    params:
      event_type: document_uploaded
      extract_fields:
        - document_id
        - document_text
        - metadata
    output: raw_document

  - id: authenticate_indexing_service
    op: authenticate
    params:
      service: indexing_service
      method: service_account
      scopes:
        - vector_db:write
        - embedding_model:invoke
    output: auth_token

  - id: validate_anonymization
    op: validate
    params:
      input: raw_document.document_text
      checks:
        - type: pii_detection
          scanner: pii_scanner
          categories:
            - names
            - emails
            - phone_numbers
            - addresses
            - social_security_numbers
            - credit_card_numbers
          action_on_fail: reject
      error_message: "Document contains PII and must be anonymized before indexing."
    output: anonymization_validation_result

  - id: chunk_document
    op: split_text
    params:
      input: raw_document.document_text
      strategy: overlapping_window
      chunk_size: 512
      chunk_overlap: 64
      metadata:
        source_document_id: raw_document.document_id
        document_metadata: raw_document.metadata
    output: document_chunks

  - id: generate_embeddings
    op: embed
    params:
      auth_token: auth_token
      model: embedding_model
      inputs: document_chunks
      batch_size: 64
      input_field: chunk_text
    output: chunk_embeddings

  - id: store_embeddings
    op: vector_db_upsert
    params:
      auth_token: auth_token
      database: vector_store
      collection: document_embeddings
      records: chunk_embeddings
      fields:
        vector: embedding
        payload:
          chunk_text: chunk_text
          source_document_id: raw_document.document_id
          chunk_index: chunk_index
          document_metadata: raw_document.metadata
      dedup_key:
        - source_document_id
        - chunk_index
    output: upsert_result

              - table: teams

              - table: games
                foreign_key: league_id
            prevent_delete_if_active: true

    params:
      recipient: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"

      form_type: game_scheduling
      required_fields:
        - home_team_id
        - away_team_id
        - league_id
        - game_date
        - game_time
        - venue
    output: form_data

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: auth_verify
    params:
      user_id: "{{ form_data.submitted_by }}"
      required_role: admin
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_team_league_membership
    op: database_query
    params:
      query: >
        SELECT team_id FROM league_teams
        WHERE league_id = :league_id
        AND team_id IN (:home_team_id, :away_team_id)
      bindings:
        league_id: "{{ form_data.league_id }}"
        home_team_id: "{{ form_data.home_team_id }}"
        away_team_id: "{{ form_data.away_team_id }}"
      expected_count: 2
      error_message: "Both home and away teams must belong to the specified league."
    output: league_membership_result

  - id: check_scheduling_conflicts
    op: database_query
    params:
      query: >
        SELECT game_id, home_team_id, away_team_id FROM games
        WHERE game_date = :game_date
        AND status IN ('scheduled', 'live')
        AND (home_team_id IN (:home_team_id, :away_team_id)
             OR away_team_id IN (:home_team_id, :away_team_id))
      bindings:
        game_date: "{{ form_data.game_date }}"
        home_team_id: "{{ form_data.home_team_id }}"
        away_team_id: "{{ form_data.away_team_id }}"
    output: conflict_results

  - id: apply_conflict_rule
    op: condition_check
    params:
      condition: "{{ conflict_results.row_count == 0 }}"
      on_true: continue
      on_false: abort
      error_message: "Scheduling conflict detected: a team cannot play two games on the same date."

  - id: insert_game_record
    op: database_insert
    params:
      table: games
      record:
        home_team_id: "{{ form_data.home_team_id }}"
        away_team_id: "{{ form_data.away_team_id }}"
        league_id: "{{ form_data.league_id }}"
        game_date: "{{ form_data.game_date }}"
        game_time: "{{ form_data.game_time }}"
        venue: "{{ form_data.venue }}"
        status: scheduled
        created_by: "{{ form_data.submitted_by }}"
        created_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output: game_record

    op: receive_upload
    params:
      source: dropzone_interface
      required_fields:
        - file
        - parent_request_id
    output:
      file: uploaded_file
      parent_request_id: parent_request_id

  - id: validate_parent_request
    op: lookup_record
    params:
      table: requests
      filter:
        id: "{{ parent_request_id }}"
    output:
      request_record: request_record
    on_failure:
      error: "Parent request not found. Attachment must be linked to an existing request."

  - id: validate_file_type_and_size
    op: validate_file
    params:
      file: "{{ uploaded_file }}"
      allowed_types:
        - application/pdf
        - image/png
        - image/jpeg
        - application/msword
        - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
        - application/vnd.ms-excel
        - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
        - text/plain
      max_size_mb: 25
    output:
      validation_result: file_validation_result
    on_failure:
      error: "File validation failed. Please check the file type and size constraints."

  - id: store_attachment_file
    op: store_file
    params:
      file: "{{ uploaded_file }}"
      storage_path: "attachments/{{ parent_request_id }}"
    output:
      stored_file_path: stored_file_path
      stored_file_url: stored_file_url

  - id: insert_attachment_record
    op: insert_record
    params:
      table: attachments
      fields:
        request_id: "{{ parent_request_id }}"
        file_name: "{{ uploaded_file.name }}"
        file_type: "{{ uploaded_file.content_type }}"
        file_size: "{{ uploaded_file.size }}"
        file_path: "{{ stored_file_path }}"
        file_url: "{{ stored_file_url }}"
        uploaded_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output:
      attachment_id: attachment_id

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: user_authentication_and_session_initialization
steps:
  - id: intercept_request
    op: request_interceptor
    params:
      intercept_all: true
      check: session_authenticated
      session_timeout_hours: 8
    output: auth_status

  - id: redirect_if_unauthenticated
    op: conditional_redirect
    params:
      condition: "auth_status.authenticated == false AND auth_status.request_path != '/login'"
      redirect_to: /login
    output: redirect_result

  - id: receive_login_submission
    op: form_receiver
    params:
      endpoint: /login
      method: POST
      fields:
        - name: username
          required: true
        - name: password
          required: true
    output: login_credentials

  - id: verify_credentials
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      username: "{{ login_credentials.username }}"
      password: "{{ login_credentials.password }}"
      actions:
        - lookup_user_record
        - verify_password_hash
        - retrieve_assigned_role
    output: auth_result

  - id: handle_auth_failure
    op: conditional_response
    params:
      condition: "auth_result.success == false"
      response:
        redirect_to: /login
        flash_message: "Invalid username or password. Please try again."
    output: failure_response

  - id: establish_session
    op: create_session
    params:
      condition: "auth_result.success == true"
      user_id: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
      username: "{{ auth_result.username }}"
      role: "{{ auth_result.role }}"
      session_timeout_hours: 8
      session_attributes:
        authenticated: true
        role: "{{ auth_result.role }}"
        permissions: "{{ auth_result.permissions }}"
        visible_menus: "{{ auth_result.role_menus }}"
        login_timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
    output: session_info

  - id: redirect_to_main_menu
    op: redirect
    params:
      condition: "session_info.created == true"
      redirect_to: /main-menu
      role_based_view: "{{ session_info.role }}"
    output: redirect_main

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: patient_registration
steps:
  - id: receive_registration_form
    op: receive_form
    params:
      form_type: new_patient_registration
      required_fields:
        - patient_first_name
        - patient_last_name
        - date_of_birth
        - address
        - phone_number
        - insurance_flag
        - taxable
        - language
    output: registration_data

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate
    params:
      role_required: office_staff
      source: submitting_user
    output: authenticated_user

  - id: validate_patient_fields
    op: validate_fields
    params:
      record: "{{registration_data}}"
      rules:
        - field: insurance_flag
          type: boolean
        - field: taxable
          type: boolean
          description: "Determines whether provincial sales taxes are applied to billing"
        - field: language
          type: enum
          allowed_values:
            - EN
            - FR
          description: "Determines invoice template selection: EN for English, FR for French"
        - field: date_of_birth
          type: date
          format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
        - field: patient_first_name
          type: string
          min_length: 1
        - field: patient_last_name
          type: string
          min_length: 1
        - field: phone_number
          type: string
          pattern: "^\\+?[0-9\\-\\s\\(\\)]+$"
    output: validated_data

  - id: check_duplicate_patient
    op: duplicate_check
    params:
      source: patient_registry
      match_fields:
        - patient_first_name
        - patient_last_name
        - date_of_birth
      record: "{{validated_data}}"
      on_duplicate: reject
    output: duplicate_check_result

  - id: store_patient_record
    op: create_record
    params:
      target: patient_registry
      record: "{{validated_data}}"
      metadata:
        registered_by: "{{authenticated_user.user_id}}"
        registered_at: "{{now}}"
        invoice_template: "{{validated_data.language}}"
        apply_provincial_tax: "{{validated_data.taxable}}"
    output: stored_patient_record

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: timesheet_daily_entry

steps:
  - id: receive_cell_update
    op: capture_ajax_request
    params:
      source: timesheet_editable_grid
      expected_fields:
        - composite_key
        - new_value
    output:
      composite_key: "{{request.composite_key}}"
      new_value: "{{request.new_value}}"
      session_token: "{{request.session_token}}"

  - id: authenticate_worker
    op: authenticate
    params:
      session_token: "{{receive_cell_update.output.session_token}}"
    output:
      authenticated: "{{auth.success}}"
      authenticated_worker_id: "{{auth.worker_id}}"

  - id: parse_composite_key
    op: parse_key
    params:
      composite_key: "{{receive_cell_update.output.composite_key}}"
      delimiter: "_"
      format: "workerID_patientID_date_flag"
    output:
      worker_id: "{{parsed.workerID}}"
      patient_id: "{{parsed.patientID}}"
      date: "{{parsed.date}}"
      entry_type: "{{parsed.flag}}"

  - id: authorize_ownership
    op: assert
    params:
      condition: "{{parse_composite_key.output.worker_id}} == {{authenticate_worker.output.authenticated_worker_id}}"
      error_message: "Workers can only edit their own timesheet entries."

  - id: check_timesheet_status
    op: database_lookup
    params:
      table: timesheets
      filters:
        worker_id: "{{parse_composite_key.output.worker_id}}"
        date: "{{parse_composite_key.output.date}}"
      return_fields:
        - status
    output:
      timesheet_status: "{{result.status}}"

  - id: assert_draft_status
    op: assert
    params:
      condition: "{{check_timesheet_status.output.timesheet_status}} == 1"
      error_message: "Timesheet must be in draft status (status=1) to accept edits."

  - id: validate_value
    op: validate
    params:
      value: "{{receive_cell_update.output.new_value}}"
      entry_type: "{{parse_composite_key.output.entry_type}}"
      rules:
        - rule: is_numeric
          error_message: "Value must be a valid number."
        - rule: non_negative
          error_message: "Value must not be negative."
        - rule: max_hours
          condition: "{{parse_composite_key.output.entry_type}} == 'hours'"
          max: 24
          error_message: "Hours per patient per day cannot exceed 24."
        - rule: max_kilometres
          condition: "{{parse_composite_key.output.entry_type}} == 'km'"
          max: 9999
          error_message: "Kilometres value exceeds maximum allowed."
    output:
      validated: true

  - id: update_timesheet_detail
    op: database_upsert
    params:
      table: timesheet_details
      match_keys:
        worker_id: "{{parse_composite_key.output.worker_id}}"
        patient_id: "{{parse_composite_key.output.patient_id}}"
        date: "{{parse_composite_key.output.date}}"
        entry_type: "{{parse_composite_key.output.entry_type}}"
      set_fields:
        value: "{{receive_cell_update.output.new_value}}"
        updated_at: "{{now}}"
        updated_by: "{{authenticate_worker.output.authenticated_worker_id}}"
    output:
      success: "{{result.success}}"
      record_id: "{{result.record_id}}"

workflow_id: food_label_ai_scanning
steps:
  - id: receive_image
    op: capture_image
    params:
      source: phone_camera
      trigger: user_photo_capture
    output: raw_image

  - id: validate_image
    op: validate_image
    params:
      input: raw_image
      allowed_formats:
        - jpeg
        - png
        - heic
      max_size_mb: 20
      min_resolution: 640x480
    output: validated_image

  - id: extract_nutritional_data
    op: call_ai_vision_api
    params:
      input: validated_image
      model: food_label_ocr_vision
      extraction_fields:
        - product_name
        - serving_size
        - servings_per_container
        - calories
        - total_fat
        - saturated_fat
        - trans_fat
        - cholesterol
        - sodium
        - total_carbohydrates
        - dietary_fiber
        - total_sugars
        - added_sugars
        - protein
        - vitamins_and_minerals
      confidence_threshold: 0.75
    output: ai_raw_response

  - id: parse_ai_response
    op: parse_nutrition_response
    params:
      input: ai_raw_response
      required_fields:
        - calories
        - total_fat
        - total_carbohydrates
        - protein
        - serving_size
      normalize_units: true
    output: parsed_nutrition_data

  - id: validate_nutritional_data
    op: validate_plausibility
    params:
      input: parsed_nutrition_data
      rules:
        - field: calories
          min: 0
          max: 2000
          flag_above: 2000
        - field: total_fat
          min: 0
          max: 200
          flag_above: 200
        - field: total_carbohydrates
          min: 0
          max: 500
          flag_above: 500
        - field: protein
          min: 0
          max: 300
          flag_above: 300
        - field: sodium
          min: 0
          max: 10000
          flag_above: 10000
      on_implausible: flag_for_review
    output: validation_result

  - id: return_prepopulated_form
    op: render_food_entry_form
    params:
      nutrition_data: parsed_nutrition_data
      validation_result: validation_result
      show_flags: true
      flag_message: "Some values appear unusual. Please review before confirming."
      editable: true
      requires_user_confirmation: true
      actions:
        - confirm_entry
        - edit_entry
        - discard
    output: food_entry_form_response

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: workout_session_logging

steps:
  - id: receive_session_data
    op: receive_input
    params:
      source: user_submission
      required_fields:
        - user_id
        - session_date
        - exercises:
            - exercise_name
            - sets
            - reps
            - weight
    output: raw_session_data

  - id: validate_session_data
    op: validate
    params:
      input: raw_session_data
      rules:
        - field: user_id
          check: not_empty
        - field: session_date
          check: valid_date
        - field: exercises
          check: non_empty_list
        - field: exercises.*.sets
          check: positive_integer
        - field: exercises.*.reps
          check: positive_integer
        - field: exercises.*.weight
          check: non_negative_number
    output: validated_session_data

  - id: lookup_training_plan
    op: database_query
    params:
      collection: training_plans
      filters:
        user_id: validated_session_data.user_id
        status: active
    output: active_training_plan

  - id: verify_active_plan_exists
    op: assert
    params:
      condition: active_training_plan != null
      error_message: "User does not have an active training plan. Session must be linked to an active plan."

  - id: compute_exercise_volumes
    op: transform
    params:
      input: validated_session_data.exercises
      for_each_exercise:
        compute:
          volume:
            expression: "exercise.sets * exercise.reps * exercise.weight"
    output: exercises_with_volume

  - id: store_workout_session
    op: database_insert
    params:
      collection: workout_sessions
      record:
        user_id: validated_session_data.user_id
        session_date: validated_session_data.session_date
        training_plan_id: active_training_plan.id
        exercises: exercises_with_volume
        total_volume:
          expression: "sum(exercises_with_volume.*.volume)"
        created_at: now()
    output: stored_session

  - id: update_training_plan_progress
    op: database_update
    params:
      collection: training_plans
      filter:
        id: active_training_plan.id
      update:
        increment:
          completed_sessions: 1
        append:
          session_history:
            session_id: stored_session.id
            session_date: validated_session_data.session_date
            total_volume: stored_session.total_volume
        set:
          last_session_date: validated_session_data.session_date
    output: updated_training_plan

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: weekly_workout_plan_generation
steps:
  - id: authenticate_user
    op: auth/verify_token
    params:
      source: request
      method: bearer_token
    output: user_session

  - id: read_fitness_profile
    op: database/read
    params:
      collection: user_profiles
      user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
      fields:
        - fitness_goals
        - fitness_level
        - available_equipment
        - age
        - weight
        - height
        - injuries
        - restrictions
    output: fitness_profile

  - id: read_workout_history
    op: database/query
    params:
      collection: workout_history
      user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
      sort_by: date
      sort_order: descending
      limit: 30
      fields:
        - date
        - exercises
        - sets
        - reps
        - weights
        - duration
        - perceived_difficulty
    output: recent_history

  - id: generate_weekly_plan
    op: ai/generate
    params:
      model: fitness-plan-generator
      prompt_template: weekly_workout_plan
      inputs:
        fitness_profile: "{{ fitness_profile }}"
        workout_history: "{{ recent_history }}"
      constraints:
        plan_duration_days: 7
        respect_equipment: true
        respect_injuries: true
        progressive_overload: true
    output: generated_plan

  - id: validate_plan_safety
    op: validation/check_workout_plan
    params:
      plan: "{{ generated_plan }}"
      user_profile: "{{ fitness_profile }}"
      recent_history: "{{ recent_history }}"
      rules:
        - max_volume_increase_percent: 10
        - required_rest_days_min: 1
        - no_exercises_conflicting_with_injuries: true
        - heart_rate_zones_appropriate_for_level: true
        - max_consecutive_training_days: 5
    output: validation_result

  - id: deactivate_previous_plan
    op: database/update
    params:
      collection: training_plans
      filter:
        user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
        status: active
      update:
        status: archived
        archived_at: "{{ now() }}"
    depends_on:
      - validate_plan_safety
    condition: "{{ validation_result.is_valid == true }}"

  - id: store_and_activate_plan
    op: database/write
    params:
      collection: training_plans
      document:
        user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
        plan: "{{ generated_plan }}"
        status: active
        created_at: "{{ now() }}"
        valid_from: "{{ next_monday() }}"
        valid_to: "{{ next_monday_plus_days(7) }}"
        validation_report: "{{ validation_result }}"
    depends_on:
      - deactivate_previous_plan
    output: saved_plan

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: body_weight_measurement_logging
steps:
  - id: receive_measurement
    op: capture_input
    params:
      fields:
        - name: user_id
          type: string
          required: true
        - name: weight_kg
          type: number
          required: true
        - name: measurement_date
          type: date
          required: true
        - name: measurement_time
          type: time
          required: true
    output: raw_measurement

  - id: validate_plausible_range
    op: validate
    params:
      input: raw_measurement.weight_kg
      rules:
        - condition: "weight_kg >= 30 AND weight_kg <= 300"
          on_fail: reject
          error_message: "Weight measurement outside plausible range (30-300 kg). Measurement rejected."
    output: validated_measurement

  - id: check_existing_measurement_today
    op: query
    params:
      source: weight_measurements
      filters:
        user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
        measurement_date: raw_measurement.measurement_date
    output: existing_today

  - id: warn_duplicate_daily_entry
    op: conditional
    params:
      condition: "existing_today.count > 0"
      on_true:
        op: notify_user
        params:
          user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
          message: "You already have a weight measurement logged for today. Only one measurement per day is recommended. The new measurement will overwrite the previous one."
      on_false:
        op: noop

  - id: store_measurement
    op: upsert
    params:
      target: weight_measurements
      key:
        user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
        measurement_date: raw_measurement.measurement_date
      data:
        user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
        weight_kg: validated_measurement.weight_kg
        measurement_date: raw_measurement.measurement_date
        measurement_time: raw_measurement.measurement_time
        recorded_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output: stored_measurement

  - id: confirm_logged
    op: notify_user
    params:
      user_id: raw_measurement.user_id
      message: "Weight measurement of {{ validated_measurement.weight_kg }} kg on {{ raw_measurement.measurement_date }} has been logged successfully."

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: claim_and_claimant_intake
steps:
  - id: receive_intake_form
    op: receive_form_submission
    params:
      source: case_staff
      form_type: new_claimant_intake
    output: intake_form_data

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate
    params:
      user_id: "{{ intake_form_data.submitting_user_id }}"
      required_role: case_staff
    output: auth_result
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "Intake Auth Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: validate_claimant_fields
    op: validate_fields
    params:
      data: "{{ intake_form_data }}"
      required_fields:
        - first_name
        - last_name
        - date_of_birth
        - ssn
        - employer_name
        - date_of_injury
        - injury_description
    output: validation_result
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "Intake Validation Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: apply_tenant_branching
    op: tenant_branch
    params:
      tenant_id: "{{ intake_form_data.client_database }}"
      branching_rule: select_field_list
      available_tenants:
        - tenant_a
        - tenant_b
        - tenant_c
    output: tenant_field_list
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "Tenant Branching Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: compute_next_claimant_id
    op: generate_sequential_id
    params:
      tenant_id: "{{ intake_form_data.client_database }}"
      entity_type: claimant
      strategy: next_available
    output: new_claimant_id
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "Claimant ID Generation Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: insert_claimant_record
    op: database_insert
    params:
      tenant_id: "{{ intake_form_data.client_database }}"
      table: claimants
      fields: "{{ tenant_field_list }}"
      values:
        claimant_id: "{{ new_claimant_id }}"
        first_name: "{{ intake_form_data.first_name }}"
        last_name: "{{ intake_form_data.last_name }}"
        date_of_birth: "{{ intake_form_data.date_of_birth }}"
        ssn: "{{ intake_form_data.ssn }}"
        created_by: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
      transaction_group: claimant_intake_txn
    output: claimant_record
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "Claimant Record Insert Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: insert_wc_case_stub
    op: database_insert
    params:
      tenant_id: "{{ intake_form_data.client_database }}"
      table: workers_comp_cases
      values:
        claimant_id: "{{ new_claimant_id }}"
        employer_name: "{{ intake_form_data.employer_name }}"
        date_of_injury: "{{ intake_form_data.date_of_injury }}"
        injury_description: "{{ intake_form_data.injury_description }}"
        status: new
        created_by: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
      transaction_group: claimant_intake_txn
    output: wc_case_record
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "WC Case Stub Insert Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: insert_placeholder_icd_codes
    op: database_insert
    params:
      tenant_id: "{{ intake_form_data.client_database }}"
      table: icd_codes
      values:
        claimant_id: "{{ new_claimant_id }}"
        case_id: "{{ wc_case_record.case_id }}"
        icd_code: PLACEHOLDER
        status: pending_review
      transaction_group: claimant_intake_txn
    output: icd_code_rows
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "ICD Code Placeholder Insert Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: insert_placeholder_rtw_rows
    op: database_insert
    params:
      tenant_id: "{{ intake_form_data.client_database }}"
      table: return_to_work
      values:
        claimant_id: "{{ new_claimant_id }}"
        case_id: "{{ wc_case_record.case_id }}"
        rtw_status: pending
        target_date: null
      transaction_group: claimant_intake_txn
    output: rtw_rows
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "RTW Placeholder Insert Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

  - id: log_activity_and_insert_tickler
    op: composite_insert
    params:
      tenant_id: "{{ intake_form_data.client_database }}"
      transaction_group: claimant_intake_txn
      inserts:
        - table: activity_log
          values:
            claimant_id: "{{ new_claimant_id }}"
            case_id: "{{ wc_case_record.case_id }}"
            activity_type: New Patient Set Up
            performed_by: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
            timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
        - table: ticklers
          values:
            claimant_id: "{{ new_claimant_id }}"
            case_id: "{{ wc_case_record.case_id }}"
            tickler_type: default_follow_up
            due_date: "{{ now() | add_days(30) }}"
            assigned_to: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
            status: open
            created_by: "{{ auth_result.user_id }}"
    output: activity_and_tickler_result
    on_failure:
      op: send_email
      params:
        to: internal_staff
        subject: "Activity Log / Tickler Insert Failure"
        body: "{{ intake_form_data | dump }}"

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: case_tickler_follow_up_management

steps:
  - id: receive_tickler_request
    op: receive_request
    params:
      source: claim_record_ui
      accepted_actions:
        - create
        - update
        - complete
      required_fields:
        - action_type
        - claim_id
        - case_manager_id
        - tickler_date
        - tickler_reason
    output: tickler_request

  - id: authenticate_case_manager
    op: authenticate
    params:
      identity_source: tickler_request.case_manager_id
      method: session_token
      role_required: case_manager
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_tickler_fields
    op: validate
    params:
      input: tickler_request
      rules:
        - field: claim_id
          type: string
          required: true
        - field: case_manager_id
          type: string
          required: true
        - field: tickler_date
          type: date
          required: true
          constraint: must_be_today_or_future
        - field: tickler_reason
          type: string
          required: true
          max_length: 500
        - field: action_type
          type: enum
          allowed_values:
            - create
            - update
            - complete
          required: true
        - field: assigned_case_manager_id
          type: string
          required: true
    output: validated_tickler

  - id: begin_transaction
    op: database_transaction_begin
    params:
      isolation_level: read_committed
    output: transaction_handle

  - id: upsert_tickler_record
    op: database_upsert
    params:
      transaction: transaction_handle
      table: ticklers
      primary_key:
        field: tickler_id
        type: uuid
        generation: auto_generate_on_create
      record:
        claim_id: validated_tickler.claim_id
        assigned_case_manager_id: validated_tickler.assigned_case_manager_id
        tickler_date: validated_tickler.tickler_date
        tickler_reason: validated_tickler.tickler_reason
        status: >
          {% if validated_tickler.action_type == 'create' %}open
          {% elif validated_tickler.action_type == 'update' %}open
          {% elif validated_tickler.action_type == 'complete' %}completed{% endif %}
        updated_by: validated_tickler.case_manager_id
        updated_at: now()
      action: validated_tickler.action_type
    output: tickler_record
    on_failure:
      goto: rollback_transaction

  - id: log_tickler_action
    op: database_insert
    params:
      transaction: transaction_handle
      table: tickler_audit_log
      record:
        log_id:
          type: uuid
          generation: auto_generate
        tickler_id: tickler_record.tickler_id
        claim_id: validated_tickler.claim_id
        action_type: validated_tickler.action_type
        performed_by: validated_tickler.case_manager_id
        assigned_to: validated_tickler.assigned_case_manager_id
        timestamp: now()
        details: validated_tickler.tickler_reason
    output: audit_log_entry
    on_failure:
      goto: rollback_transaction

  - id: commit_transaction
    op: database_transaction_commit
    params:
      transaction: transaction_handle
    output: commit_result

  - id: return_success_response
    op: respond
    params:
      status: 200
      body:
        message: Tickler action completed successfully
        tickler_id: tickler_record.tickler_id
        action: validated_tickler.action_type
        status: tickler_record.status

  - id: rollback_transaction
    op: database_transaction_rollback
    params:
      transaction: transaction_handle
    output: rollback_result
    next: return_error_response

  - id: return_error_response
    op: respond
    params:
      status: 500
      body:
        message: Tickler action failed. Transaction rolled back.
        claim_id: validated_tickler.claim_id
        action: validated_tickler.action_type

steps:

    params:

      method: POST
      endpoint: /api/cleanup
      content_type: application/json
      expected_payload:
        - extracted_text
    output: raw_request

  - id: validate_cors_origin
    op: validate_origin
    params:
      request: "{{raw_request}}"
      allowed_origins:
        - "https://<username>.github.io"
      reject_on_mismatch: true
      error_response:
        status: 403
        body: "Origin not allowed"
    output: validated_request

  - id: forward_to_llm
    op: http_post
    params:
      url: "{{LLM_API_ENDPOINT}}"
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{LLM_API_KEY}}"
        Content-Type: application/json
      body:
        model: "{{LLM_MODEL}}"
        messages:
          - role: system
            content: >
              Tu es un assistant de nettoyage de texte. Tu reçois un extrait de texte
              issu d'un livre numérisé. Supprime les numéros de page, les en-têtes
              courants, les notes de bas de page, et les artefacts de césure
              (traits d'union en fin de ligne avec mot coupé). Retourne uniquement
              le texte nettoyé, sans commentaire ni explication.
          - role: user
            content: "{{validated_request.extracted_text}}"
      timeout_seconds: 30
      no_storage: true
      no_logging_of_payload: true
    output: llm_response

  - id: receive_cleaned_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{llm_response}}"
      field: choices[0].message.content
      trim_whitespace: true
    output: cleaned_text

  - id: return_cleaned_text
    op: send_response
    params:
      status: 200
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json
        Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "https://<username>.github.io"
        Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST
        Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type
      body:
        cleaned_text: "{{cleaned_text}}"
      no_data_retention: true

steps:

    op: receive_input
    params:
      input_type: cleaned_text_sections

    output: text_sections

  - id: split_into_sentences
    op: tokenize_sentences
    params:

      strategy: sentence_boundary_detection
      locale: fr-FR
      description: Split each section into individual sentences for the utterance queue
    output: sectioned_sentences

  - id: create_utterances
    op: create_speech_synthesis_utterances
    params:
      source: "{{sectioned_sentences}}"
      engine: browser_native_web_speech_api
      lang: fr-FR

      pitch: "{{user_config.pitch | default(1.0)}}"
      description: Create a SpeechSynthesisUtterance for each sentence with user-configured rate and pitch
    output: utterance_list

  - id: apply_inter_section_pauses
    op: insert_pauses_between_sections
    params:
      utterances: "{{utterance_list}}"
      sections: "{{sectioned_sentences}}"
      pause_duration_ms: "{{user_config.inter_section_pause_ms | default(800)}}"
      description: Insert a configurable silence pause between the last utterance of one section and the first utterance of the next
    output: utterance_queue

  - id: queue_utterances
    op: enqueue_to_speech_api
    params:

          params:
            css_class: tts-active-sentence

        - action: scroll_into_view
          params:
            target: "{{current_utterance.sentence_element_id}}"
            behavior: smooth
            block: center

    output: event_bindings

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: pwa_offline_asset_caching

steps:
  - id: precache_critical_assets
    op: service_worker_install
    params:
      event: install
      cache_name: pwa-critical-v1
      critical_assets:
        - /index.html
        - /manifest.json
        - /styles/main.css
        - /scripts/app.js
        - /scripts/sw-register.js
        - /icons/icon-192.png
        - /icons/icon-512.png
        - /offline.html
      exclude_patterns:
        - /api/llm-cleanup/**
    output: precache_result

  - id: activate_and_cleanup_old_caches
    op: service_worker_activate
    params:
      event: activate
      expected_cache_names:
        - pwa-critical-v1
        - pwa-runtime-v1
      action: delete_unexpected_caches
    output: activation_result

  - id: intercept_fetch_request
    op: service_worker_fetch
    params:
      event: fetch
      capture_request_url: true
      capture_request_method: true
    output: intercepted_request

  - id: check_if_llm_cleanup_endpoint
    op: url_pattern_match
    params:
      url: "{{ intercepted_request.url }}"
      patterns:
        - /api/llm-cleanup/**
    output: is_llm_cleanup

  - id: enforce_network_only_for_llm_cleanup
    op: conditional_branch
    params:
      condition: "{{ is_llm_cleanup.matched }}"
      if_true: fetch_from_network_only
      if_false: apply_cache_first_strategy

  - id: fetch_from_network_only
    op: network_fetch
    params:
      request: "{{ intercepted_request }}"
      timeout_ms: 30000
      on_failure: return_network_error
    output: llm_network_response

  - id: return_network_error
    op: respond
    params:
      status: 503
      body: '{"error": "LLM cleanup requires an active network connection."}'
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json

  - id: apply_cache_first_strategy
    op: cache_match
    params:
      cache_names:
        - pwa-critical-v1
        - pwa-runtime-v1
      request: "{{ intercepted_request }}"
    output: cache_hit

  - id: evaluate_cache_hit
    op: conditional_branch
    params:
      condition: "{{ cache_hit.found }}"
      if_true: serve_cached_response
      if_false: fallback_to_network

  - id: serve_cached_response
    op: respond
    params:
      response: "{{ cache_hit.response }}"
    output: served_from_cache

  - id: fallback_to_network
    op: network_fetch
    params:
      request: "{{ intercepted_request }}"
      timeout_ms: 10000
    output: network_response

  - id: check_network_success
    op: conditional_branch
    params:
      condition: "{{ network_response.ok }}"
      if_true: cache_and_serve_network_response
      if_false: serve_offline_fallback

  - id: cache_and_serve_network_response
    op: cache_put
    params:
      cache_name: pwa-runtime-v1
      request: "{{ intercepted_request }}"
      response: "{{ network_response }}"
      exclude_patterns:
        - /api/llm-cleanup/**
    output: cached_network_response

  - id: serve_network_response
    op: respond
    params:
      response: "{{ network_response }}"
    output: served_from_network

  - id: serve_offline_fallback
    op: cache_match
    params:
      cache_names:
        - pwa-critical-v1
      request: /offline.html
    output: offline_page

  - id: respond_with_offline_page
    op: respond
    params:
      response: "{{ offline_page.response }}"
      fallback_status: 503
      fallback_body: "You are offline and this resource is not cached."

      compute_hash: true
      hash_algorithm: sha256
    output: extracted_documents
    # Each item: { file_path, source_pdf, raw_text, sha256_hash, extraction_method }

  - id: anonymize_text
    op: pii_anonymization
    params:
      documents: "{{extracted_documents}}"
      entities_to_redact:
        - doctor_names
        - hospital_names
        - addresses
        - phone_numbers
        - email_addresses
      token_format: "[REDACTED_{entity_type}_{index}]"
      preserve:
        - clinical_values
        - lab_results
        - medication_dosages
        - dates_clinical
        - numeric_measurements
      mapping_output_path: ./tmp/anonymization_mappings/
      audit_log: true
    output: anonymized_documents
    # Each item: { file_path, anonymized_text, pii_mapping, sha256_hash, source_pdf }

  - id: structure_to_markdown
    op: ai_markdown_structuring
    params:
      documents: "{{anonymized_documents}}"
      primary_model: "{{env.PRIMARY_AI_MODEL}}"
      fallback_model: "{{env.FALLBACK_AI_MODEL}}"
      prompt_template: ./templates/medical_document_structuring.prompt
      use_fallback_on_verification_failure: true
      max_retries: 2
      output_format: markdown
    output: structured_documents
    # Each item: { file_path, markdown_content, model_used, anonymized_text, sha256_hash, source_pdf }

  - id: verify_content_integrity
    op: content_verification
    params:
      documents: "{{structured_documents}}"
      checks:
        - type: numeric_preservation
          description: "All numbers from source appear unchanged in Markdown"
        - type: date_preservation
          description: "All dates from source appear unchanged in Markdown"
        - type: clinical_value_preservation
          description: "All clinical values intact"
      compare_source_field: anonymized_text
      compare_target_field: markdown_content
      confidence_levels:
        high: all_checks_pass
        medium: minor_discrepancies
        low: any_check_fails
    output: verified_documents
    # Each item adds: { confidence, verification_report }

  - id: route_by_confidence
    op: conditional_split
    params:
      input: "{{verified_documents}}"
      condition_field: confidence
      routes:
        - match: low
          output_key: low_confidence_docs
        - match_any: [high, medium]
          output_key: approved_docs
    output:
      low_confidence_docs: low_confidence_docs
      approved_docs: approved_docs

  - id: enqueue_low_confidence_for_review
    op: review_queue_append
    params:
      documents: "{{low_confidence_docs}}"
      queue_path: ./state/review_queue.json
      include_fields:
        - source_pdf
        - sha256_hash
        - confidence
        - verification_report
        - model_used
      timestamp: true
      audit_log: true
    output: review_queue_entries

  - id: write_markdown_and_metadata
    op: file_write_batch
    params:
      documents: "{{approved_docs}}"
      markdown_output_dir: ./raw/
      markdown_filename_template: "{{source_pdf.name | replace('.pdf', '.md')}}"
      metadata_output_dir: ./raw/
      metadata_filename_template: "{{source_pdf.name | replace('.pdf', '.meta.json')}}"
      metadata_fields:
        - sha256_hash
        - source_pdf
        - extraction_method
        - model_used
        - confidence
        - verification_report
        - processing_timestamp
      overwrite: false
    output: written_files

  - id: authenticate_git
    op: git_auth
    params:
      method: ssh_key
      ssh_key_path: "{{env.GIT_SSH_KEY_PATH}}"
      repository_path: ./raw/
    output: git_session

  - id: commit_documents
    op: git_commit_batch
    params:
      session: "{{git_session}}"
      repository_path: ./raw/
      files: "{{written_files}}"
      commit_message_template: "Add processed medical document: {{filename}} [confidence={{confidence}}] [hash={{sha256_hash}}]"
      author_name: medical-doc-pipeline
      author_email: "{{env.PIPELINE_GIT_EMAIL}}"
    output: pending_commits

  - id: push_on_threshold
    op: conditional_git_push
    params:
      session: "{{git_session}}"
      repository_path: ./raw/
      pending_commits: "{{pending_commits}}"
      push_every_n_documents: 10
      remote: origin
      branch: main
      force: false
      push_remaining_at_end: true
    output: push_results

  - id: cleanup_tmp
    op: directory_cleanup
    params:
      directories:
        - ./tmp/downloads/
        - ./tmp/anonymization_mappings/
      recursive: true
      ignore_errors: false
    output: cleanup_status

  - id: write_run_log
    op: log_entry_write
    params:
      log_path: ./logs/pipeline_runs.jsonl
      entry:
        run_id: "{{run.id}}"
        timestamp: "{{run.timestamp}}"
        total_new_pdfs_found: "{{new_pdf_list | length}}"
        total_downloaded: "{{downloaded_pdf_paths | length}}"
        total_extracted: "{{extracted_documents | length}}"
        total_anonymized: "{{anonymized_documents | length}}"
        total_structured: "{{structured_documents | length}}"
        total_approved: "{{approved_docs | length}}"
        total_sent_to_review: "{{low_confidence_docs | length}}"
        total_committed: "{{pending_commits | length}}"
        total_pushed: "{{push_results.pushed_count}}"
        cleanup_status: "{{cleanup_status}}"
        errors: "{{run.errors}}"
    output: run_log_entry

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_clinical_analysis_pipeline

steps:
  - id: receive_pdf_upload
    op: receive_upload
    params:
      file_type: application/pdf
      require_authentication: true
      max_file_size_mb: 100
    output: uploaded_pdf

  - id: extract_text
    op: pdf_text_extraction
    params:
      source: "{{uploaded_pdf}}"
      primary_method: digital_extraction
      fallback_method: ocr
      ocr_engine: tesseract
      preserve_structure: true
    output: raw_extracted_text

  - id: anonymize_text
    op: pii_anonymization
    params:
      input_text: "{{raw_extracted_text}}"
      hard_gate: true
      abort_pipeline_on_failure: true
      methods:
        - named_entity_recognition
        - regex_pattern_matching
        - date_shifting
      entity_types:
        - name
        - dob
        - ssn
        - mrn
        - address
        - phone
        - email
        - insurance_id
      validation: strict
    output: anonymized_text
    on_failure: abort

  - id: ingest_into_wiki
    op: wiki_ingest
    params:
      content: "{{anonymized_text}}"
      encryption_at_rest: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      case_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.case_id}}"
      create_pages_by_section: true
      tag_source: pdf_upload
    output: wiki_state

  - id: check_wiki_page_threshold
    op: conditional_gate
    params:
      condition: "{{wiki_state.page_count}} >= 3"
      wait_if_unmet: false
      proceed_if_met: true
    output: wiki_threshold_met

  - id: pubmed_literature_search
    op: literature_search
    params:
      enabled: "{{wiki_threshold_met}}"
      source: pubmed
      query_from: "{{wiki_state.key_terms}}"
      max_results: 50
      filters:
        - peer_reviewed: true
      encrypt_results: true
    output: literature_results

  - id: adversarial_analysis_loop
    op: adversarial_loop
    params:
      input_wiki: "{{wiki_state}}"
      literature: "{{literature_results}}"
      anonymized_text: "{{anonymized_text}}"
      max_iterations: 8
      convergence_threshold: 0.10
      encrypt_prompts: true
      encrypt_responses: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      two_tier_separation:
        documented_findings: true
        inferred_findings: true
      sub_steps:
        - id: run_iteration
          op: llm_adversarial_pass
          params:
            iteration: "{{current_iteration}}"
            challenger_prompt: true
            defender_prompt: true
            encrypt_at_rest: true
          output: iteration_result

        - id: check_convergence
          op: convergence_check
          params:
            current_result: "{{iteration_result}}"
            previous_result: "{{previous_iteration_result}}"
            threshold: 0.10
            metric: delta_score
          output: convergence_status

        - id: loop_control
          op: loop_decision
          params:
            converged: "{{convergence_status.converged}}"
            iteration: "{{current_iteration}}"
            max_iterations: 8
          output: continue_loop
    output: adversarial_findings

  - id: validate_nct_numbers
    op: nct_validation
    params:
      findings: "{{adversarial_findings}}"
      validation_source: clinicaltrials_gov_api
      remove_invalid: true
      flag_unverified: true
    output: validated_findings

  - id: generate_two_tier_report
    op: report_generation
    params:
      findings: "{{validated_findings}}"
      literature: "{{literature_results}}"
      tiers:
        - tier: documented
          label: "Evidence-Based Documented Findings"
          source_required: true
        - tier: inferred
          label: "AI-Inferred Findings"
          confidence_scores: true
      separation_enforced: true
      encrypt_content: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      format: structured_json_and_pdf
    output: two_tier_report

  - id: update_wiki_with_findings
    op: wiki_update
    params:
      case_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.case_id}}"
      content: "{{validated_findings}}"
      report_reference: "{{two_tier_report.id}}"
      encryption_at_rest: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
    output: updated_wiki_state

  - id: log_pipeline_run
    op: audit_log
    params:
      pipeline_id: full_clinical_analysis_pipeline
      case_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.case_id}}"
      steps_completed:
        - receive_pdf_upload
        - extract_text
        - anonymize_text
        - ingest_into_wiki
        - check_wiki_page_threshold
        - pubmed_literature_search
        - adversarial_analysis_loop
        - validate_nct_numbers
        - generate_two_tier_report
        - update_wiki_with_findings
      adversarial_iterations: "{{adversarial_findings.iterations_run}}"
      convergence_achieved: "{{adversarial_findings.converged}}"
      timestamp: "{{now}}"
      user_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.user_id}}"
      encrypt_log: true

  - id: final_pii_validation
    op: pii_scan
    params:
      content: "{{two_tier_report}}"
      scan_mode: exhaustive
      entity_types:
        - name
        - dob
        - ssn
        - mrn
        - address
        - phone
        - email
        - insurance_id
      fail_on_detection: true
      abort_delivery_on_failure: true
    output: pii_validation_result

  - id: serve_encrypted_report
    op: secure_delivery
    params:
      report: "{{two_tier_report}}"
      pii_clean: "{{pii_validation_result.clean}}"
      require_authentication: true
      user_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.user_id}}"
      encryption_in_transit: TLS_1_3
      encryption_at_rest: AES-256-GCM
      access_logging: true
    output: delivery_confirmation

steps:
  - id: intercept_request
    op: middleware/check_session

      timeout_hours: 8
    output: session_status

  - id: redirect_to_login
    op: http/redirect
    params:
      condition: "{{ session_status.authenticated == false }}"
      target_url: /admin/login

  - id: establish_session

    params:

        error_message: "Invalid username or password. Please try again."

workflow_id: post_install_geocoding_service_partner_lookup

steps:
  - id: receive_registration_form
    op: receive_form
    params:
      form_type: post_install_registration
      required_fields:
        - unit_id
        - customer_name
        - installation_address
        - installation_city
        - installation_state
        - installation_zip
        - installation_country
    output: registration_data

  - id: geocode_address
    op: api_call
    params:
      service: external_maps_api
      endpoint: /geocode
      method: POST
      payload:
        address: "{{ registration_data.installation_address }}"
        city: "{{ registration_data.installation_city }}"
        state: "{{ registration_data.installation_state }}"
        zip: "{{ registration_data.installation_zip }}"
        country: "{{ registration_data.installation_country }}"
    output: geocoder_raw_response

  - id: parse_geocoder_response
    op: transform
    params:
      action: extract_fields
      source: "{{ geocoder_raw_response }}"
      fields:
        latitude: "{{ geocoder_raw_response.results[0].geometry.location.lat }}"
        longitude: "{{ geocoder_raw_response.results[0].geometry.location.lng }}"
    output: installation_coordinates

  - id: read_service_partners
    op: database_query
    params:
      datasource: service_partners_db
      query: "SELECT partner_id, partner_name, address, latitude, longitude, phone, email FROM authorized_service_partners WHERE active = true"
    output: all_service_partners

  - id: compute_distances
    op: transform
    params:
      action: haversine_distance
      origin:
        latitude: "{{ installation_coordinates.latitude }}"
        longitude: "{{ installation_coordinates.longitude }}"
      targets: "{{ all_service_partners }}"
      target_lat_field: latitude
      target_lng_field: longitude
      output_field: distance_km
    output: partners_with_distances

  - id: filter_partners_within_threshold
    op: filter
    params:
      source: "{{ partners_with_distances }}"
      condition: "distance_km <= max_distance_threshold_km"
      max_distance_threshold_km: 100
      sort_by: distance_km
      sort_order: ascending
    output: eligible_partners

  - id: return_nearest_partner
    op: transform
    params:
      action: select_first
      source: "{{ eligible_partners }}"
      fields:
        partner_id: partner_id
        partner_name: partner_name
        address: address
        phone: phone
        email: email
        distance_km: distance_km
      fallback_message: "No authorized service partner found within the distance threshold."
    output: nearest_service_partner
