attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: whatsapp_text_message_ingestion

steps:
  - id: extract_and_normalise
    op: extract_fields
    params:
      source: webhook.payload
      fields:
        - name: sender_phone
          path: entry[0].changes[0].value.messages[0].from
        - name: sender_name
          path: entry[0].changes[0].value.contacts[0].profile.name
        - name: recipient_phone
          path: entry[0].changes[0].value.metadata.display_phone_number
        - name: message_text
          path: entry[0].changes[0].value.messages[0].text.body
        - name: message_id
          path: entry[0].changes[0].value.messages[0].id
        - name: timestamp
          path: entry[0].changes[0].value.messages[0].timestamp
      normalise:
        sender_phone: e164
        recipient_phone: e164
        timestamp: iso8601
    output: message

  - id: mask_sensitive_data
    op: regex_mask
    params:
      input_text: "{{ message.message_text }}"
      rules:
        - pattern: '\b(?:\d[ -]*?){13,16}\b'
          label: CREDIT_CARD
          replacement: "[TARJETA_ENMASCARADA]"
        - pattern: '\b\d{7,8}\b'
          label: DNI
          replacement: "[DNI_ENMASCARADO]"
        - pattern: '\b\d{22}\b'
          label: CBU
          replacement: "[CBU_ENMASCARADO]"
        - pattern: '\b[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9.]{5,19}\b'
          label: ALIAS_CBU
          replacement: "[ALIAS_ENMASCARADO]"
    output: sanitised

  - id: classify_message
    op: http_request
    params:
      method: POST
      url: "{{ config.ai_classification_api_url }}"
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{ secrets.ai_api_key }}"
        Content-Type: application/json
      body:
        text: "{{ sanitised.masked_text }}"
        sender_phone: "{{ message.sender_phone }}"
      timeout_seconds: 15
      retries: 2
    output: classification

  - id: check_es_laboral
    op: conditional
    params:
      condition: "{{ classification.body.es_laboral == false }}"
      on_true:
        action: terminate
        reason: "Message classified as non-work request (es_laboral=false). No ticket created."
    output: gate

  - id: lookup_producer
    op: database_query
    params:
      datasource: brokerage_db
      query: >
        SELECT producer_id, producer_name, producer_email
        FROM producers
        WHERE whatsapp_number = :recipient_phone
        LIMIT 1
      bind:
        recipient_phone: "{{ message.recipient_phone }}"
    output: producer

  - id: create_or_update_client
    op: database_upsert
    params:
      datasource: brokerage_db
      table: clients
      match_on:
        phone: "{{ message.sender_phone }}"
      set:
        phone: "{{ message.sender_phone }}"
        name: "{{ message.sender_name }}"
        producer_id: "{{ producer.producer_id }}"
        last_contact: "{{ message.timestamp }}"
    output: client

  - id: create_ticket
    op: database_insert
    params:
      datasource: brokerage_db
      table: tickets
      record:
        client_id: "{{ client.id }}"
        producer_id: "{{ producer.producer_id }}"
        source: whatsapp
        source_message_id: "{{ message.message_id }}"
        classification_label: "{{ classification.body.label }}"
        classification_confidence: "{{ classification.body.confidence }}"
        status: open
        created_at: "{{ message.timestamp }}"
    output: ticket

  - id: record_first_message
    op: database_insert
    params:
      datasource: brokerage_db
      table: ticket_messages
      record:
        ticket_id: "{{ ticket.id }}"
        direction: inbound
        sender_phone: "{{ message.sender_phone }}"
        original_text: "{{ message.message_text }}"
        sanitised_text: "{{ sanitised.masked_text }}"
        whatsapp_message_id: "{{ message.message_id }}"
        timestamp: "{{ message.timestamp }}"
    output: message_log_entry

workflow_id: whatsapp_audio_message_ingestion

steps:

    op: parse_webhook_payload
    params:
      source: trigger.body
      expected_type: audio
      fields:
        - message_id
        - from_number
        - to_number
        - audio_id
        - timestamp
        - profile_name
    output: message_metadata

  - id: download_audio
    op: http_request
    params:
      method: GET
      url: "https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/{{message_metadata.audio_id}}"
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{secrets.whatsapp_api_token}}"
      response_type: binary
    output: audio_binary

  - id: transcribe_audio
    op: call_transcription_api
    params:
      endpoint: "{{config.transcription_api_url}}"
      audio_data: "{{audio_binary}}"
      language: es
      format: auto
    output: transcription_result

  - id: mask_sensitive_data
    op: pii_masking
    params:
      text: "{{transcription_result.text}}"
      entities_to_mask:
        - phone_number
        - email
        - national_id
        - credit_card
        - address
        - date_of_birth
        - bank_account
    output: sanitised_text

  - id: classify_message
    op: call_ai_classification_api
    params:
      endpoint: "{{config.ai_classification_api_url}}"
      text: "{{sanitised_text.masked_text}}"
      classification_schema:
        - es_laboral
        - category
        - subcategory
        - urgency
    output: classification_result

  - id: check_es_laboral
    op: conditional
    params:
      condition: "{{classification_result.es_laboral}} == false"
      on_true:
        op: terminate_workflow
        params:
          reason: "Message classified as non-work request (es_laboral=false)"
          log:
            message_id: "{{message_metadata.message_id}}"
            from: "{{message_metadata.from_number}}"
            classification: "{{classification_result}}"

  - id: lookup_producer
    op: database_query
    params:
      datasource: producers
      operation: find
      filter:
        assigned_number: "{{message_metadata.to_number}}"
    output: producer_record

  - id: create_or_update_client
    op: upsert_record
    params:
      datasource: clients
      match_fields:

      record:
        phone_number: "{{message_metadata.from_number}}"
        profile_name: "{{message_metadata.profile_name}}"
        producer_id: "{{producer_record.producer_id}}"
        last_contact: "{{message_metadata.timestamp}}"
    output: client_record

    params:

        client_id: "{{client_record.client_id}}"

        source: whatsapp_audio
        category: "{{classification_result.category}}"
        subcategory: "{{classification_result.subcategory}}"
        urgency: "{{classification_result.urgency}}"
        es_laboral: true
        status: open
        created_at: "{{message_metadata.timestamp}}"
        original_message_id: "{{message_metadata.message_id}}"
    output: ticket_record

  - id: log_transcribed_message
    op: create_record
    params:
      datasource: ticket_messages
      record:
        ticket_id: "{{ticket_record.ticket_id}}"
        message_id: "{{message_metadata.message_id}}"
        direction: inbound
        message_type: audio_transcription
        content: "{{sanitised_text.masked_text}}"
        original_audio_id: "{{message_metadata.audio_id}}"
        timestamp: "{{message_metadata.timestamp}}"
        from_number: "{{message_metadata.from_number}}"

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: daily_ticket_summary_email
trigger:
  type: schedule
  cron: "0 11 * * 1-5"
  timezone: America/New_York
steps:
  - id: fetch_open_tickets
    op: database.query
    params:
      source: tickets_db
      query: >
        SELECT t.ticket_id, t.subject, t.status, t.priority, t.producer_id,
               t.created_at, t.last_status_update,
               p.full_name AS producer_name, p.email AS producer_email
        FROM tickets t
        JOIN producers p ON t.producer_id = p.producer_id
        WHERE t.status != 'cerrado'
          AND t.archived = false
          AND t.visible = true
        ORDER BY t.producer_id, t.created_at
    output: open_tickets

  - id: group_and_calculate_stale
    op: transform.group_and_enrich
    params:
      input: "{{ open_tickets }}"
      group_by: producer_id
      computed_fields:
        - name: hours_since_update
          expression: "ROUND((NOW() - last_status_update) / 3600, 1)"
        - name: is_stalled
          expression: "hours_since_update > 4"
      include_producer_metadata:
        - producer_name
        - producer_email
    output: grouped_by_producer

  - id: format_summary_emails
    op: template.render
    params:
      input: "{{ grouped_by_producer }}"
      iterate_over: producers
      template: |
        Subject: Daily Open Tickets Summary - {{ current_date }}

        Hello {{ producer.producer_name }},

        Here is your daily summary of open tickets as of {{ current_time }}:

        Total Open Tickets: {{ producer.tickets | length }}
        Stalled Tickets (>4 hrs): {{ producer.tickets | selectattr('is_stalled', 'true') | list | length }}

        {% for ticket in producer.tickets %}
        --------------------------------------------------
        {% if ticket.is_stalled %}⚠️ WARNING: STALLED ({{ ticket.hours_since_update }} hrs without update){% endif %}
        Ticket ID:    {{ ticket.ticket_id }}
        Subject:      {{ ticket.subject }}
        Status:       {{ ticket.status }}
        Priority:     {{ ticket.priority }}
        Created:      {{ ticket.created_at }}
        Last Updated: {{ ticket.last_status_update }}
        Hours Since Update: {{ ticket.hours_since_update }}
        --------------------------------------------------
        {% endfor %}

        Please review and update any stalled tickets at your earliest convenience.

        — Ticket Management System
      output_fields:
        - to
        - subject
        - body
    output: formatted_emails

  - id: send_summary_emails
    op: email.send_batch
    params:
      input: "{{ formatted_emails }}"
      iterate_over: emails
      email:
        to: "{{ email.producer_email }}"
        subject: "{{ email.subject }}"
        body: "{{ email.body }}"
        content_type: text/plain
        from: noreply@brokerage-tickets.com
        reply_to: support@brokerage-tickets.com
      retry:
        max_attempts: 3
        backoff_seconds: 30
    output: send_results

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: ticket_producer_assignment
steps:
  - id: receive_assignment_request
    op: receive_event
    params:
      event_type: producer_assignment_requested
      required_fields:
        - ticket_id
        - producer_id
        - manager_id
    output:
      ticket_id: "{{ event.ticket_id }}"
      producer_id: "{{ event.producer_id }}"
      manager_id: "{{ event.manager_id }}"

  - id: validate_ticket_unassigned
    op: database_query
    params:
      query: "SELECT id, assigned_to, status FROM tickets WHERE id = :ticket_id"
      bind:
        ticket_id: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.ticket_id }}"
      assertions:
        - condition: "{{ result.rows | length == 1 }}"
          error: "Ticket not found"
        - condition: "{{ result.rows[0].assigned_to is none }}"
          error: "Ticket is already assigned. Only unassigned tickets (assigned_to IS NULL) can be assigned via this workflow."
    output:
      ticket: "{{ result.rows[0] }}"

  - id: validate_producer_active
    op: database_query
    params:
      query: "SELECT id, name, email, status FROM producers WHERE id = :producer_id"
      bind:
        producer_id: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.producer_id }}"
      assertions:
        - condition: "{{ result.rows | length == 1 }}"
          error: "Producer not found"
        - condition: "{{ result.rows[0].status == 'active' }}"
          error: "Producer is not active and cannot be assigned tickets"
    output:
      producer: "{{ result.rows[0] }}"

  - id: update_ticket_assignment
    op: database_update
    params:
      table: tickets
      where:
        id: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.ticket_id }}"
        assigned_to: null
      set:
        assigned_to: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.producer_id }}"
        status: "pendiente"
        updated_at: "{{ now() }}"
      expected_affected_rows: 1
    output:
      updated: true

  - id: log_status_change
    op: database_insert
    params:
      table: ticket_history
      record:
        ticket_id: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.ticket_id }}"
        previous_status: "{{ steps.validate_ticket_unassigned.output.ticket.status }}"
        new_status: "pendiente"
        previous_assigned_to: null
        new_assigned_to: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.producer_id }}"
        changed_by: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.manager_id }}"
        change_type: "producer_assignment"
        created_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output:
      history_entry_id: "{{ result.inserted_id }}"

  - id: notify_assigned_producer
    op: send_notification
    params:
      channel: email
      recipient: "{{ steps.validate_producer_active.output.producer.email }}"
      template: ticket_assigned
      template_data:
        producer_name: "{{ steps.validate_producer_active.output.producer.name }}"
        ticket_id: "{{ steps.receive_assignment_request.output.ticket_id }}"
        status: "pendiente"
    output:
      notification_sent: true

      target_ticket_id: "{{ event.target_ticket_id }}"

      table: tickets

      duplicate_ticket: "{{ result }}"

  - id: read_target_ticket
    op: database_read
    params:
      table: tickets

      target_ticket: "{{ result }}"

  - id: extract_message_content
    op: extract_field

      source: "{{ duplicate_ticket }}"

  - id: append_message_to_target

    params:
      table: ticket_messages

      message:
        content: "{{ extracted_message }}"
        source_ticket_id: "{{ duplicate_ticket_id }}"
        appended_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output:
      updated_message_log: "{{ result }}"

  - id: update_target_resumen
    op: ai_summarize
    params:
      existing_resumen: "{{ target_ticket.resumen }}"
      new_message: "{{ extracted_message }}"
      instruction: "Update the resumen only if the new message adds meaningful information. Return the original resumen unchanged if no new information is present."
    output:
      updated_resumen: "{{ result }}"

  - id: save_updated_resumen
    op: database_update
    params:
      table: tickets
      record_id: "{{ target_ticket_id }}"
      fields:
        resumen: "{{ updated_resumen }}"

  - id: archive_duplicate_ticket
    op: database_update
    params:
      table: tickets
      record_id: "{{ duplicate_ticket_id }}"
      fields:
        visible: false
        status: archived
        archived_at: "{{ now() }}"
        archived_reason: "merged_into_{{ target_ticket_id }}"

  - id: log_merge_action
    op: database_insert
    params:
      table: ticket_history
      record:
        ticket_id: "{{ target_ticket_id }}"
        action: ticket_merge
        details:
          merged_from_ticket_id: "{{ duplicate_ticket_id }}"

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: client_record_upsert

steps:
  - id: extract_client_identifier
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{trigger.message}}"
      fields:
        - name
        - email
        - channel
    output: client_identifier

  - id: validate_identifier
    op: validate
    params:
      conditions:
        - field: "{{client_identifier.channel}}"
          operator: equals
          value: whatsapp
          then_check:
            field: "{{client_identifier.name}}"
            not_empty: true
        - field: "{{client_identifier.channel}}"
          operator: equals
          value: email
          then_check:
            field: "{{client_identifier.email}}"
            not_empty: true
      error_message: "Client identifier is empty. WhatsApp requires name; email channel requires email address."
    output: validation_result

  - id: determine_dedup_key
    op: conditional
    params:
      cases:
        - when: "{{client_identifier.channel}} == 'whatsapp'"
          result:
            dedup_field: name
            dedup_value: "{{client_identifier.name}}"
        - when: "{{client_identifier.channel}} == 'email'"
          result:
            dedup_field: email
            dedup_value: "{{client_identifier.email}}"
    output: dedup_key

  - id: check_existing_client
    op: db_lookup
    params:
      collection: clients
      filter:
        "{{dedup_key.dedup_field}}": "{{dedup_key.dedup_value}}"
    output: existing_client

  - id: upsert_client_record
    op: db_upsert
    params:
      collection: clients
      match_field: "{{dedup_key.dedup_field}}"
      match_value: "{{dedup_key.dedup_value}}"
      record:
        name: "{{client_identifier.name}}"
        email: "{{client_identifier.email}}"
        channel: "{{client_identifier.channel}}"
        last_contact: "{{trigger.message.timestamp}}"
      on_conflict: update_existing
    output: upserted_client

  - id: extract_client_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{upserted_client}}"
      fields:
        - client_id
    output: client_id

    output: sitemap_xml

      input: "{{page_urls}}"
      size: 10
    output: url_batches

  - id: process_batches
    op: loop/for_each
    params:
      items: "{{url_batches}}"
      variable: batch
      wait_between: 5000
    steps:
      - id: fetch_page_content
        op: loop/for_each
        params:
          items: "{{batch}}"
          variable: page_url
          on_error: skip
        steps:

            params:

              headers:

              input: "{{page_html.body}}"
              selector: ".main_content"

            op: vectorstore/upsert
            params:
              namespace: knowledge_base

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: incoming_email_classification

steps:
  - id: poll_inbox
    op: gmail/poll
    params:
      account: club_inbox
      interval_minutes: 5
      filter: "is:unread"
    output: new_emails

  - id: extract_email_fields
    op: transform/extract
    params:
      source: "{{ new_emails }}"
      fields:
        - email_body
        - thread_id
        - sender_address
    output: email_metadata

  - id: retrieve_full_thread
    op: gmail/get_thread
    params:
      account: club_inbox
      thread_id: "{{ email_metadata.thread_id }}"
    output: thread_messages

  - id: build_thread_history
    op: transform/map
    params:
      source: "{{ thread_messages }}"
      mapping:
        role: |
          {% if message.sender_address ends_with '@club.example.com' %}
            Club
          {% else %}
            Customer
          {% endif %}
        body: "{{ message.body }}"
        timestamp: "{{ message.timestamp }}"
        sender: "{{ message.sender_address }}"
    output: labeled_thread_history

  - id: check_internal_sender
    op: condition/check
    params:
      condition: "{{ email_metadata.sender_address ends_with '@club.example.com' }}"
    output: is_internal_sender

  - id: classify_email
    op: ai/classify
    params:
      skip_if: "{{ is_internal_sender }}"
      model: gpt-4
      system_prompt: >
        You are a multilingual (EN/FR/ES) email classification agent for a club
        operating in Montreal. Given an email thread, determine whether the latest
        inbound message requires a customer support response.

        Rules:
        - If the sender domain is @club.example.com, always return customerSupport = false.
        - If the message references a tax receipt request (including but not limited to
          "Releve 24", "RL-24", "relevé 24", "rl-24"), always return customerSupport = true.
        - Evaluate the message in its original language (EN, FR, or ES).

        Respond with a JSON object: { "customerSupport": true/false, "reason": "..." }
      messages:
        - role: system
          content: "Thread history (labeled Club/Customer):\n{{ labeled_thread_history }}"
        - role: user
          content: "Latest email from {{ email_metadata.sender_address }}:\n{{ email_metadata.email_body }}"
      response_format: json
    output: classification_result

  - id: finalize_classification
    op: transform/merge
    params:
      result: |
        {% if is_internal_sender %}
          { "customerSupport": false, "reason": "Sender is internal @club.example.com" }
        {% else %}
          {{ classification_result }}
        {% endif %}
      metadata:
        thread_id: "{{ email_metadata.thread_id }}"
        sender_address: "{{ email_metadata.sender_address }}"
    output: final_classification

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_email_support_pipeline

steps:
  - id: poll_inbox
    op: gmail/poll
    params:
      mailbox: club_inbox
      interval_minutes: 5
      filter: is:unread
    output: new_emails

  - id: extract_email_fields
    op: email/extract
    params:
      source: "{{ new_emails }}"
      fields:
        - body
        - thread_id
        - sender_address
    output: email_data

  - id: retrieve_thread
    op: gmail/get_thread
    params:
      thread_id: "{{ email_data.thread_id }}"
    output: full_thread

  - id: build_thread_history
    op: thread/build_history
    params:
      thread: "{{ full_thread }}"
      label_by: sender_type
      sender_types:
        - customer
        - agent
        - system
    output: thread_history

  - id: classify_email
    op: llm/classify
    params:
      input: "{{ email_data.body }}"
      context: "{{ thread_history }}"
      categories:
        - customer_support_request
        - not_customer_support
    output: classification

  - id: route_classification
    op: control/branch
    params:
      condition: "{{ classification.category == 'customer_support_request' }}"
      on_false:
        - id: log_skip
          op: audit/log
          params:
            event: email_skipped
            reason: not_customer_support
            sender: "{{ email_data.sender_address }}"
            thread_id: "{{ email_data.thread_id }}"
      on_true: continue

  - id: search_customer_support_docs
    op: knowledge_base/search
    params:
      kb_id: customerSupportDocs
      query: "{{ email_data.body }}"
      context: "{{ thread_history }}"
    output: kb_results_support

  - id: search_club_documents
    op: knowledge_base/search
    params:
      kb_id: clubDocuments
      query: "{{ email_data.body }}"
      context: "{{ thread_history }}"
    output: kb_results_club

  - id: search_previous_email_responses
    op: knowledge_base/search
    params:
      kb_id: previousEmailResponses
      query: "{{ email_data.body }}"
      context: "{{ thread_history }}"
    output: kb_results_previous

  - id: detect_language_and_season
    op: llm/analyze
    params:
      input: "{{ email_data.body }}"
      tasks:
        - detect_language:
            supported: [EN, FR, ES]
        - apply_season_mapping:
            rules:
              Fall: Winter
              winter_months: Oct-Apr
              Spring: Summer
              summer_months: May-Sep
    output: language_and_season

  - id: generate_draft_response
    op: llm/generate
    params:
      prompt: >
        Using ONLY the following knowledge base results, generate a helpful
        customer support response. Do not include information outside of
        the provided knowledge base content.
      context:
        thread_history: "{{ thread_history }}"
        kb_customer_support: "{{ kb_results_support }}"
        kb_club_documents: "{{ kb_results_club }}"
        kb_previous_responses: "{{ kb_results_previous }}"
      language: "{{ language_and_season.detected_language }}"
      season_mapping: "{{ language_and_season.season_mapping }}"
    output: draft_body

  - id: create_gmail_draft
    op: gmail/create_draft
    params:
      thread_id: "{{ email_data.thread_id }}"
      to: "{{ email_data.sender_address }}"
      body: "{{ draft_body }}"
      language: "{{ language_and_season.detected_language }}"
      send: false
    output: draft_metadata

  - id: log_draft_creation
    op: audit/log
    params:
      event: draft_created
      thread_id: "{{ email_data.thread_id }}"
      sender: "{{ email_data.sender_address }}"
      language: "{{ language_and_season.detected_language }}"
      draft_id: "{{ draft_metadata.draft_id }}"
      knowledge_bases_searched:
        - customerSupportDocs
        - clubDocuments
        - previousEmailResponses
      timestamp: "{{ now() }}"

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: timesheet_hours_entry
steps:
  - id: receive_timesheet_form
    op: receive_form_submission
    params:
      required_fields:
        - user_id
        - date
        - hours
        - role
        - rate
    output: timesheet_entry

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate
    params:
      user_id: "{{ timesheet_entry.user_id }}"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_entry_date
    op: validate_date_range
    params:
      entry_date: "{{ timesheet_entry.date }}"
      range: active_timesheet_period
    output: date_validation
    on_failure:
      action: reject
      message: "Entry date does not fall within the currently active timesheet date range."

  - id: check_overlapping_entries
    op: query_database
    params:
      table: timesheet_entries
      filters:
        user_id: "{{ timesheet_entry.user_id }}"
        date: "{{ timesheet_entry.date }}"
        role: "{{ timesheet_entry.role }}"
    output: existing_entries

  - id: reject_if_overlap
    op: conditional
    params:
      condition: "{{ existing_entries | length > 0 }}"
      on_true:
        action: reject
        message: "An overlapping timesheet entry already exists for this user, date, and role."
      on_false:
        action: continue

  - id: compute_total_pay
    op: calculate
    params:
      expression: "{{ timesheet_entry.hours }} * {{ timesheet_entry.rate }}"
    output: total_pay

  - id: insert_timesheet_record
    op: insert_database
    params:
      table: timesheet_entries
      record:
        user_id: "{{ timesheet_entry.user_id }}"
        date: "{{ timesheet_entry.date }}"
        hours: "{{ timesheet_entry.hours }}"
        role: "{{ timesheet_entry.role }}"
        rate: "{{ timesheet_entry.rate }}"
        total_pay: "{{ total_pay }}"
        created_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output: inserted_record

attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: timesheet_hours_edit

steps:
  - id: receive_edit_form
    op: receive_form_submission
    params:
      trigger: timesheet_edit_submitted
      required_fields:
        - record_id
        - staff_id
        - date
        - start_time
        - end_time
        - hourly_rate
    output: edit_payload

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate
    params:
      user_id: "{{ edit_payload.staff_id }}"
      session_token: "{{ edit_payload.session_token }}"
    output: auth_result

  - id: read_existing_record
    op: database_read
    params:
      table: timesheet_entries
      filter:
        id: "{{ edit_payload.record_id }}"
    output: existing_record

  - id: check_overlapping_entries
    op: database_query
    params:
      table: timesheet_entries
      filter:
        staff_id: "{{ edit_payload.staff_id }}"
        date: "{{ edit_payload.date }}"
        exclude_record_id: "{{ edit_payload.record_id }}"
        overlaps_with:
          start_time: "{{ edit_payload.start_time }}"
          end_time: "{{ edit_payload.end_time }}"
      description: "Check for overlapping timesheet entries, excluding the record being edited"
    output: overlapping_entries

  - id: validate_no_overlap
    op: assert
    params:
      condition: "{{ overlapping_entries | length == 0 }}"
      error_message: "Updated timesheet entry overlaps with an existing entry for this staff member on the same date."

  - id: compute_updated_pay
    op: calculate
    params:
      hours_worked: "( {{ edit_payload.end_time }} - {{ edit_payload.start_time }} ) / 3600"
      hourly_rate: "{{ edit_payload.hourly_rate }}"
      total_pay: "{{ hours_worked * hourly_rate }}"
    output: pay_calculation

  - id: update_timesheet_record
    op: database_update
    params:
      table: timesheet_entries
      filter:
        id: "{{ edit_payload.record_id }}"
      update_fields:
        date: "{{ edit_payload.date }}"
        start_time: "{{ edit_payload.start_time }}"
        end_time: "{{ edit_payload.end_time }}"
        hourly_rate: "{{ edit_payload.hourly_rate }}"
        hours_worked: "{{ pay_calculation.hours_worked }}"
        total_pay: "{{ pay_calculation.total_pay }}"
        updated_at: "{{ now() }}"
    output: updated_record
